title: Optimization Error
description: Represents an infeasible configuration or validation failure.

oneOf.description: The problem cannot be satisfied due to conflicting constraints.
The input parameters are malformed or invalid.

CapacityConflict.title: Capacity Overflow Conflict Details
CapacityConflict.description: Identifies which resource limit is exceeded and by which items.

bundle_ids.description: List of item IDs included in this bundle.

dimension.description: The resource dimension index (0-based) that overflowed.

root_id.description: The root item triggering this capacity check.

ChainConflict.title: Logical Chain Conflict Details
ChainConflict.description: Identifies a conflict where a dependency chain leads to a mutually exclusive item.

conflicting_id.description: The prerequisite item that conflicts with the root.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the chain conflict.

path_ids.description: Ordered list of item IDs forming the requirement path (e.g., [A, B, C]).

ConflictReport.title: Conflict Analysis Report
ConflictReport.description: Structured diagnostic report explaining why a problem instance is infeasible.

capacity_conflicts.description: Detailed list of resource capacity overflows.

is_feasible.description: True if the configuration satisfies all constraints.

logical_chain_conflicts.description: Detailed list of prerequisite and mutual exclusion chain conflicts.

target_conflict.description: Target value unreachability conflict, if a target was specified.

TargetConflict.title: Target Value Conflict Details
TargetConflict.description: Identifies when a target objective score cannot be achieved.

achievable_value.description: The maximum achievable score under constraints.
